Non reentrant for the same RatioID. Parameters (in) RatioID Ratio Identifier reporting that a respective monitor could have found a fault - only used when interface option "API" is selected Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK report of IUMPR result was successfully reported Description Service for reporting that faults are possibly found because all conditions are fullfilled. API is needed in OBD-relevant ECUs only API Availability: This API will be available only if ({ecuc(Dem/DemGeneral.DemOBDSupport)} != DEM_OBD_NO_OBD_SUPPORT) Available via Dem.h
